canaries.assertion: The file is written against production evidence: Nakamoto's real tx hash, tokenId, registry address and wallet are fixture constants at the top, so a test asserting that real data is ignored cannot pass unnoticed.
Every canary a candidate invariant claims must resolve on disk, and `verifiedFailingBeforeFix: false` is surfaced as a milestone-close warning rather than being invisible.

statement: A regression canary is valid only if it demonstrably fails against the historical defect and passes against the verified resolution. A green test that encodes the defective assumption is evidence of instrument failure, not protection.

occurrences.defect: Six passing tests while the resolver could never work. One was titled 'ignores a receipt with no structured registration block' and fed it exactly the shape of Nakamoto's real receipt — the bug was specified, asserted and defended by a green test. Another asserted the lookup uses the agent's persona, encoding OS-6's bug as a REQUIREMENT.

Two pre-existing canaries had pinned the defective shape (the stage ordinal lock rule; the title heuristic's location in the panel) and failed against the corrected code. Both were replaced with recorded reasons.

A canary asserted the old confidence behaviour — that a source with no invariant lineage is capped and quarantined — i.e. it required the circular-prerequisite defect. Replaced with a comment saying so and why.

A canary pinned the literal sentence 'Awaiting Runes indexer' for the TESTNET row — a label describing a mechanism the resolver no longer uses, since testnet B¢ comes from primary chain data. The green test was requiring a stale shape.
